description: Order lifecycle events emitted by the storefront when customers place, confirm, ship, or receive orders. Each order produces up to four events in sequence: placed → confirmed → shipped → delivered.

fields.event_id: Unique event identifier within the orders.events stream (e.g., evt-001). Monotonically increasing string key.
fields.order_id: Imazon order identifier — joins to shipping.carrier_status.order_id in PostgreSQL and to imazon.shipping.updates.order_id in Kafka.
fields.event_type: Lifecycle stage of the order at the time of emission: placed | confirmed | shipped | delivered.
fields.timestamp: Event UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-11-01T09:12:00Z).
fields.items: Array of {edition_id, qty} pairs describing which catalog.editions were ordered. Present only on placed events.
fields.total: Order total in the title currency (decimal). Present only on placed events.
fields.warehouse: Warehouse code assigned to fulfil the order (e.g., WH-East). Present only on confirmed events.
fields.carrier: Carrier code assigned for shipment (e.g., UPS, FedEx, DHL). Present only on shipped events.
fields.tracking: Carrier tracking number assigned at shipment — matches tracking_number in shipping.carrier_status and imazon.shipping.updates. Present only on shipped events.
fields.signed_by: Name of the recipient or proxy who signed for the delivery. Present only on delivered events.
